text:
sophie: FYI i'm opening a tiny PR to update the slim model card. plan: limits, quick bench bullets, compatibility note about quant routing, and two examples (python SDK v3 + curl).

ashley: sounds good. please call out the >4096 seq fallback explicitly (dedicated runtime has hit this).

sophie: will add a single-sentence Limit: 'Sequences >4096 may fall back to the quantized variant on constrained hosts.'

mira: for embeddings, let's include a minimal shard-aware snippet and link to the embeddings doc. example: `shard = hash(key) % num_shards; client.embeddings.create(model="slim-3b", input=[text], shard_id=shard)`

mira: anchor note: use /docs/embeddings#shard-routing (lowercase, hyphen) — previous anchor was renamed.

chris: add a short compatibility line that runtime routing may serve slim-3b requests with slim-3b-quant on low-memory nodes; mention expected perf delta.

sophie: adding: 'Quant fallback: ~1.2x latency and minor output variance; see bench CSV.'

docs-bot: bench CSV -> https://bench.redwood.internal/slim-3b/latest.csv

sophie: inline bench highlights: p4d ~420 tok/s @512; g5 ~680 tok/s. quant fallback: p4d ~330 tok/s; g5 ~520 tok/s. will reference CSV.

ashley: SDK nit: use `max_tokens` in examples (SDK v3). add migration hint: replace `length` -> `max_tokens` when upgrading v2->v3.

sophie: done. python snippet will use `client.generate(..., max_tokens=256)`. curl example mirrors the param.

chris: i'll run the MD linter and a quick wording pass once you open the PR.

sophie: branch pushed refs/heads/docs/slim-card-tidy-1758881234. PR body will include a short checklist and reviewers @ashley @mira @chris. aiming to merge tomorrow EOD if no blockers.

paul: LGTM, ping when PR is live.

mira: i'll validate the anchor and embed snippet in the PR preview.

sophie: thanks all — posting link here when it's up. :rocket:
